info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Fitness Memberships Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Cancellation API enables businesses to efficiently manage and process the cancellation of fitness memberships. This API endpoint allows authorized users to delete memberships that have been marked for cancellation, thereby streamlining administrative tasks within fitness organizations. Typical consumers include gym operators and fitness service providers looking to automate membership management processes. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can ensure accurate and up-to-date membership records, enhancing operational efficiency and customer service.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel their active membership. Successfully canceling a membership will stop all future billing and revoke access to premium features.

requestBody.description: Request payload to cancel a membership. This operation will require specific details to identify the membership that needs to be canceled. Ensure that the request conforms to the expected schema.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelRequest.description: A string representation of the request body to cancel a membership operation via DELETE request.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancel Membership Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the membership after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message about the cancellation operation.

DeleteFitnessMembershipsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a membership.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp for when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit log for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header helps in measuring the performance and response time of the API call.
